checkpoints.title: A config error names a rejected secret field and its rule, never the value
contracts: internal/config/config.go: Validate checks a non-empty [models.gateway] secret, [integrations.<name>] secret, and [identity] machine_user_secret against the secret-name rule even when the consumer is unset; secretRule names the field and the rule, never the value; URL refusals for base_url and integration url show no URL

internal/config/load.go: the checkout integration-host refusal and the active_scan url mismatch show no URL; the --set layer reports keys only, and setMap refuses an entry outside a known Config section as --set entry N without its value
instrumentation: each refusal names the config field and the rule it breaks
checkpoints.rollback: Revert the squash commit; config errors quote the value again, and no stored config needs a change.
